terra.problem: The psalm does not say whether David waits until he has his act together before praying.
The reference to being unable to get out of the drawer assumes the baker knows his backstory. It needs to establish that he was stuck in a junk drawer.
The claim that David grew up in Bethlehem is outside this psalm and has no reference.
The explanation states why David can ask with confidence, but the psalm does not say that.
The psalm calls God David’s refuge and a tower of strength; it does not say David is running to a safe place.
The reference to his years waiting in the dark draws on his backstory without establishing that he was in a junk drawer.
Referring to the statement on the card brings the app interface into Papa Dorin’s explanation.
Jesse’s relationship to David is a Bible fact from outside the passage, but it has no reference.
The description of Edom as a nation neighboring Israel is outside the passage and has no reference.
The locked drawer reference assumes the baker knows about Papa Dorin’s time in the junk drawer.
